text:
Hope Academic Academy enrolled 5 white students in 2024-25
K. B. Beebe
Hope Academic Academy enrolled five white students in the 2024-25 school year, a decline of 16.7% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Records show Hope Academic Academy enrolled 47 students in the 2024-25 school year. White students made up 10.6% of the student body, the second-largest group. African American students were the largest group, comprising 80.9% (38) of enrollment.
The school is located in Ecorse Public Schools District with a central office in Ecorse.
Of the six schools in Ecorse Public Schools District, Ecorse Community High School had the highest enrollment of white students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. The budget set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. It maintained free school meals and included full funding for pre-K and community college.

| 2018-19 | 54 | 8 | 14.8% |
| 2019-20 | 56 | 7 | 12.5% |
| 2020-21 | 49 | 10 | 20.4% |
| 2021-22 | 71 | 4 | 5.6% |
| 2022-23 | 67 | 5 | 7.5% |
| 2023-24 | 70 | 6 | 8.6% |
| 2024-25 | 47 | 5 | 10.6% |
